messages:
Lisa - Sales: Ok team — Praxis POC timeline update. Trial window is targeting Apr 8–May 8. Need final signoffs on integration tasks.
Maria (Solutions Eng): Thanks — can someone confirm API auth shape we'll provide to Praxis? Token vs mTLS?
Ajay - Eng: We'll support token initially. mTLS possible for Dedicated later. I'll own the auth config (Ajay).
Kelly - Eng PM: Owners note: Ajay -> auth, Sam -> infra/network, Maria -> test plan, Ben -> customer comms.
Sam (SE): Infra check: Praxis needs egress to our staging endpoint (staging.redwood.ai:443). Any IP allowlist? If so, give me CIDR.
Ajay - Eng: We'll open 3.120.45.0/24 and 18.205.0.0/16 for now. Sam, file a ticket to eng-infra to apply.
Maria (Solutions Eng): Success criteria proposal: 99th percentile latency < 500ms on typical prompts, 95% end-to-end success for test prompts, and no PII logged.
Ben - Customer Success: Praxis wants embeddings + chat generation. Deliverables: embeddings batch job, chat webhook, and runbook for errors.
Lisa - Sales: Can we get a staging rollout plan? Minimal steps in order would help for customer kickoff.
Kelly - Eng PM: Draft plan attached inline:
```
1) Auth & allowlist done (Ajay, Sam) — target 3/30
2) Model & config validated on staging (Maria) — target 4/3
3) End-to-end tests + perf (Maria, Sam) — target 4/5
4) Customer validation + runbook (Ben) — target 4/7
```
Sam (SE): Quick code-review ping: PR #548 adds the allowlist and token config. @Ajay please review.
Ajay - Eng: On it, aiming to merge today if no surprises.
redwood-ci: deploy/staging succeeded — build 20260402-5a3f
Maria (Solutions Eng): One blocker: Praxis uses < 64 token summaries for embeddings; we need to confirm batching won't break their ordering. I'll add a test case.
Ben - Customer Success: I'll schedule the customer kick on 4/8 and send a calendar invite once we confirm infra.
Lisa - Sales: Perfect. If any timeline slips, @Lisa - Sales flagged. Otherwise we'll run dry-run on 4/6. :thumbsup:
